title: Frontend architecture and observed baseline
author: Bijan Mousavi
why: Give reviewers an accurate map of the existing frontend, preservation boundaries and measured results before proposing behavior or deployment changes.
what: Document build/server/browser boundaries, all 45 source pages and 21 configured redirects, public configuration, observed baseline results and a concise team presentation.
how: Trace checked-out source, link each boundary to its implementation, compare the exported staged payload with the immutable application baseline, and distinguish measured results from unverified behavior.
preserved: Application source, public assets, dependencies, adapters, chart interfaces and existing CI remain byte-identical to the recorded upstream application baseline.
risk: A source inventory is not runtime coverage. Several configured redirect targets have no matching page file. Documentation records this observation without prescribing a behavior repair.
limitations: No new browser, viewer, platform or remote CI result. Baseline live-service build results are historical observations. Inherited advisories and maintainer licensing questions remain unresolved.
rollback: Revert this documentation change in a new reported commit. Contributor and report tools remain usable; application inputs are unaffected.
